svg.font-family: Hanken Grotesk, Segoe UI, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: A record card titled Every backend you can select, and how far each one goes, listing the nine buildc --target flags with the rank buildc doctor gives each one. The c row is accented as the only primary backend, the one the substrate receipt records as the production anchor. hlsl and glsl are supported shader source output, and the remaining six are experimental.

svg.text: These rows are read from the same array buildc doctor prints, so the picture cannot outlive a re-ranked backend. Three of the nine reach the
substrate receipt: c is recorded as the production anchor, rust carries an execution receipt over a corpus subset, and spirv is recorded as not yet
